name: Synced sixteenth thrum
desc: Deep, choppy amp tremolo locked to sixteenths, slightly offset L/R like several amps at once

refs.why: Marr's rhythm re-amped through several Twins with tremolo on

notes: Neon = blackface choppy; synced so it never drifts (the original had to be edited for that); 60° stereo offset mimics two amp pairs
